dedupe_keys.name: dominio publico maritimo terrestre terrenos integramente incluidos en dpmt

description: Dominio Público Marítimo Terrestre (Terrenos íntegramente incluidos en DPMT) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wmts.mapama.gob.es. Land that is included in its entirety in the maritime-terrestrial public domain, in accordance with the provisions of Law 22/1988, of July 28, on Coasts. The data that can be consulted are: province, municipality and demarcation reference that includes them. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Public Land Maritime Domain (Land fully included in DPMT)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMTS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-12-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
